_doc: PLACEHOLDER — R28-4 game menu (CLAUDE.md REINTERP AMENDMENTS §4, docs/REINTERP_RESTRUCTURE_R28_2026-07-10.md §4 layer 2). Frame-voice text is functional and near-final by nature (menu labels, the static controls list) — but still Sérgio's to confirm, especially restartConfirmBody's exact wording and whether the pauseGlyphSymbol reads right at a glance (a plain 'II' first pass, cheap to swap for an icon later). S80 adds the look-mode-3 strings: the motion* set (the on-screen button that asks for device orientation — iOS cannot be asked without a real press, so the button is a designed object) and 'recentre' (the menu row that puts forward back where the room's front is). All of it frame voice: functional, undecorated, never in the piece's own voice.
title: Menu
restartConfirmBody: This wipes everything and returns you to the start. Nothing you do is ever kept, either way.
controlsLines: On a phone or tablet, turn the device to look — the button at the bottom of the screen switches that on.
Pinch with two fingers to zoom the view in or out.
Recentre the view puts forward back where the room's front is.
Esc — or this menu's corner button — pauses.
motionEnableHint: Turn your phone or tablet to look around the room.
motionDenied: Motion access declined. Drag to look.
motionUnavailable: No motion sensor here. Drag to look.
creditsNone: No third-party assets to credit yet.
